reference_semantics.contract_guard: This expected output is not a final comparison engine, equivalence score, known-good contract, setup truth contract, scientific-validity claim, or GUI design.
reference_semantics.selected_reference: The reference is user-selected comparison context. Known-good and scientific comparability are not claimed.
reference_semantics.named_inputs: The comparison reads named measurement inputs as context, but does not define a shared run-context framework.
reference_semantics.finding_vocabulary: Findings use specific labels instead of a generic gap category.

boundary_notes: Selected reference means user-chosen comparison context, not known-good proof.
Same observed setup binding and preview metadata can make comparison easier, but do not prove scientific comparability.
Changed parameter state is a finding, not an automatic explanation of data differences.
Unverified and redacted findings should remain distinct from missing data.
The fixture compares declared context only and does not inspect raw data, run code, hardware state, or fit quality.
